frequency_question: How often does the US Treasury cross the threshold from investigating and warning major foreign banks to actually imposing severe secondary financial sanctions on a systemically important rival superpower's top-tier banks?
membership_rule: Includes any formal US Treasury designation or threat execution against a top-10 bank of a major adversary for energy transactions with a heavily sanctioned state; excludes minor boutique banks or non-bank financial intermediaries.

cases.name: Russian Major Bank Sanctions (Sectoral vs Full Blocking)
Hong Kong Autonomy Act Sanctions on Chinese Banks

coverage_note: 3 named historical flashpoints where secondary banking sanctions against major powers were actively weighed.
known_gaps: Excludes confidential waiver negotiations and private diplomatic demarches that did not reach public designation.

validity_reason: Based on structural great-power financial decoupling trends which remain active through the medium term.
